projection_matched_bf16_backward.scope: same-GEMM graph; every route input and Q/K/V weight VJP, identical upstreams and contribution order

projection_headwise_fp32_backward.scope: independent per-head oracle input and Q/K/V weight VJP; inherited CPU layout-test limits

router_bf16_forward.scope: cuda-exact versus canonical same-condition, production width H8, unequal queries and nontrivial depth sources; inherited E24 kernel limits

router_bf16_vjp.scope: canonical backward-cast oracle versus cuda-exact; values, queries and norm VJP; inherited E24 exact-VJP requirement

equal_route_forward.scope: AABC and ABBC Q outputs with equal A/B inputs and identical Q tensors; no cross-topology gradient-equality claim

uninterrupted_next_update.scope: fresh stronger gate: resumed versus uninterrupted next complete update/full state under identical intended production runtime flags; historical weaker resume pass is not sufficient
